title: Demo plan during Benvolio's call
doc_title: Friday demo for Ducal: run order

blocks.text: A recorded video of the sync as backup
A spare tablet, charged, already in airplane mode
Test the room's wifi Friday morning
PDF open in a second tab before we start
If the live sync fails: play the video, go straight to the PDF, keep talking about their yards.
Benvolio: ask about a pilot, two sites
Record backup video Thu (me and Romeo, real build)
Auditor may join, for the PDF part
Keep the PDF part plain: what it says, who signed, when
If the wifi drops mid-demo, that's very on-message (Benvolio)
